ScalingUp Daily v1.0.1 — Minor update

- Added metadata and package-lock.json files for improved dependency management.
- Updated scheduling: automation now triggers weekly (Monday 08:00) instead of daily.
- Changelog, installation, and workflow documentation improved in INSTALL.md and SKILL.md.
- Enhanced reference management and reporting template.
- Improved citation and publishing requirements with stricter link verification and dual-platform (IMA and Tencent Docs) publishing mandates.
